title: KHAN VS HUANG
sunoStyle: Epic cinematic trap hip-hop rap battle, thundering taiko and Mongolian war drums, morin khuur horsehead fiddle riff, deep 808, 92 bpm, two male English rappers, verse 1 very deep gravelly menacing commanding baritone, verse 2 smooth cocky clean mid-range tenor, rap verses only, no chorus, no announcer, no hype man, no spoken intro, no spoken outro, abrupt ending

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I built the biggest land empire, bro, before you learned to type

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: No cloud, no fiber, just a horse and a bow, no hype

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Your jacket's made of leather, mine came off the whole herd

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: My riders sent the message and they never missed a word

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You sell the shovels, bro, I took the whole gold rush

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: One horn blast from the steppe and your whole keynote goes hush

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Two hours on a stage just to launch one little chip

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I took the world on horseback with no slides and no script

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Nice horse, nice bow, but where's your compute at, big guy?

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your empire split in four, my backorders touch the sky

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: You sent a rider with a letter, I ship the entire net

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your fastest mail is slower than my fiber, don't forget

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: The more you buy, the more you save, that's how I take the land

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: You burned the cities down, I made them all my fans

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Eight hundred years and nobody has found where you lie down

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: I'm in every phone, every chat, and every town
